pitch_en: Environmental consultancy delivering circular-economy strategy, packaging-waste compliance (Clean Pack), and the Co-Workers Cloud digital marketplace for recoverable materials.
pitch_es: Consultoría ambiental que ofrece estrategia de economía circular, cumplimiento en envases y empaques (Clean Pack) y el marketplace digital Co-Workers Cloud para materiales aprovechables.
cta_pitch_en: R&R Kelab integrates regulatory consulting, collective packaging plans, and Co-Workers Cloud to connect waste generators, recyclers, and services in one circular platform.
cta_pitch_es: R&R Kelab integra consultoría regulatoria, planes colectivos de envases y Co-Workers Cloud para conectar generadores, recicladores y servicios en una plataforma circular.

sections.head_en: Industries in Colombia face complex environmental permitting, packaging-waste obligations, and fragmented markets for recoverable materials.
